text:
sophia: Quick design review — compact legend + synced time-range behavior. Dropped a new prototype in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz. Key Q: when the scrubber snaps to sampling buckets, should the compact legend update live or only after mouseup? Also the mini-legend contrast looks low.

jamal: My take — live updates feel responsive but can be noisy for keyboard users. Maybe live for pointer drag, commit on mouseup/Enter for keyboard. @ara any a11y concerns?

ara: Agree with pointer vs keyboard separation. For screen reader users we should emit an ARIA live region only after final selection to avoid spamming. Also the contrast on the mini-legend fails AA — current text color (~#6B7280) is too low.

tal: Copy nits: change 'Sampling: 1 in 10' -> 'Sampling: 10% of traces' for clarity. Also the top-right CTA 'Compare ranges' looks like a primary button but is a link; either make it a proper button visually or tone it down.

sophia: Updated the Figma with keyboard flow and added a small spec using `aria-live="polite"`. For the legend idea: show condensed badges during drag (e.g., 'p95: 180ms') and expand to full detail on mouseup. Does that feel okay?

jamal: Condensed badges sound good. Implementation note — continuous number updates can thrash layout during drag. Keep container layout fixed; only update the numeric values inside the badges.

design-bot: Accessibility checker: contrast fail detected on `.mini-legend .label` at current color. Recommend bump to #374151 or increase font-weight.

ara: Small visual affordance suggestion — when sampling is enabled, scrubber should indicate sampled vs unsampled regions (hatched or subtle overlay). For a compact pattern: 18px high hatched overlay with 40% opacity.

sophia: I'll add a short GIF prototype for the hatched overlay. One product question: should time-range presets cause the scrubber to auto-snap to the preset (hard jump) or behave advisory (no auto-jump)? I'm leaning advisory to avoid surprise.

tal: Advisory. Auto-snap can be surprising, especially for keyboard flows. Offer an optional 'snap to preset' toggle in settings for power users.

jamal: :thumbsup: I'll wire up a quick experiment with debounced live updates (300ms) and keyboard commit on Enter. Will also keep layout stable and only swap numbers.

sophia: Thanks everyone — I'll file tickets and update Figma. Tickets: DESIGN-4827 (legend contrast), DESIGN-4828 (scrubber live vs commit), DESIGN-4829 (copy + CTA style).
